list.label: Interface
list.definition:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "ana-lab",
  tag: "interface",
  predicate: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifstate" and
    r.device != "R5" and
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
)
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"

schema.tagValues(
  bucket: "ana-lab",
  tag: "interface",
  predicate: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifstate" and
    r.device != "R5" and
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
)

panels.title: Faulted Interfaces

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifstate"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "admin_status" or
    r._field == "oper_status"
  )
  |> group(columns: [
    "device",
    "interface",
    "_field"
  ])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["device", "interface"],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> reduce(
    identity: {interfaces_down: 0},
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      interfaces_down:
        accumulator.interfaces_down +
        (if exists r.admin_status and
            exists r.oper_status and
            r.admin_status == "UP" and
            r.oper_status != "UP"
         then 1
         else 0)
    })
  )

panels.description: Counts only interfaces that are administratively UP but operationally not UP. Administratively-down ports are not considered faults.

panels.title: Device Interface Summary
panels.description: Summary by device. Admin-down interfaces are shown separately from actual admin-up/oper-down faults.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifstate"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "admin_status" or
    r._field == "oper_status"
  )
  |> group(columns: [
    "device",
    "interface",
    "_field"
  ])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: [
      "device",
      "interface"
    ],
    columnKey: ["_field"],
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> reduce(
    identity: {
      total: 0,
      up: 0,
      admin_down: 0,
      faulted: 0
    },
    fn: (r, accumulator) => ({
      total:
        accumulator.total + 1,

      up:
        accumulator.up +
        (if exists r.oper_status and
            r.oper_status == "UP"
         then 1
         else 0),

      admin_down:
        accumulator.admin_down +
        (if exists r.admin_status and
            r.admin_status == "DOWN"
         then 1
         else 0),

      faulted:
        accumulator.faulted +
        (if exists r.admin_status and
            exists r.oper_status and
            r.admin_status == "UP" and
            r.oper_status != "UP"
         then 1
         else 0)
    })
  )
  |> group()
  |> rename(columns: {
    device: "Device",
    total: "Total",
    up: "Up",
    admin_down: "Admin Down",
    faulted: "Faulted"
  })
  |> keep(columns: [
    "Device",
    "Total",
    "Up",
    "Admin Down",
    "Faulted"
  ])
  |> sort(columns: ["Device"])

panels.title: Top Data-Plane Interfaces by Average Traffic (5m)
panels.description: Average combined ingress and egress throughput. Known management interfaces are excluded from this ranking but remain available in the drill-down selector.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifcounters"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    not (
      (r.vendor == "arista" and r.interface == "Management0") or
      (r.vendor == "cisco" and r.interface == "GigabitEthernet1") or
      (r.vendor == "nokia" and r.interface == "mgmt0")
    )
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "in_octets" or
    r._field == "out_octets"
  )
  |> group(columns: [
    "device",
    "interface",
    "_field"
  ])
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: 10s,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false
  )
  |> derivative(
    unit: 1s,
    nonNegative: true
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    r with
    _value: float(v: r._value) * 8.0
  }))
  |> mean(column: "_value")
  |> group(columns: [
    "device",
    "interface"
  ])
  |> sum(column: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> sort(
    columns: ["_value"],
    desc: true
  )
  |> limit(n: 10)
  |> rename(columns: {
    device: "Device",
    interface: "Interface",
    _value: "Average Traffic"
  })
  |> keep(columns: [
    "Device",
    "Interface",
    "Average Traffic"
  ])

panels.title: Problem Interfaces (empty = healthy)
panels.description: Shows true state faults plus interfaces whose error or discard counters increased during the last five minutes. Admin-down/oper-down unused ports are intentionally omitted.

targets.query:
stateProblems =
  from(bucket: "ana-lab")
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "net_ifstate"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.device != "R5"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "admin_status" or
      r._field == "oper_status"
    )
    |> group(columns: [
      "device",
      "interface",
      "_field"
    ])
    |> last()
    |> group()
    |> pivot(
      rowKey: [
        "device",
        "interface"
      ],
      columnKey: ["_field"],
      valueColumn: "_value"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      exists r.admin_status and
      exists r.oper_status and
      r.admin_status == "UP" and
      r.oper_status != "UP"
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Device: r.device,
      Interface: r.interface,
      Problem: "Admin UP / Oper not UP",
      Detail:
        r.admin_status + " / " +
        r.oper_status
    }))

counterProblems =
  from(bucket: "ana-lab")
    |> range(start: -5m)
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._measurement == "net_ifcounters"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.device != "R5"
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
    )
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._field == "in_errors" or
      r._field == "out_errors" or
      r._field == "in_discards" or
      r._field == "out_discards" or
      r._field == "in_fcs_errors"
    )
    |> group(columns: [
      "device",
      "interface",
      "_field"
    ])
    |> difference(nonNegative: true)
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      _value: float(v: r._value)
    }))
    |> group(columns: [
      "device",
      "interface"
    ])
    |> sum(column: "_value")
    |> filter(fn: (r) =>
      r._value > 0.0
    )
    |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      Device: r.device,
      Interface: r.interface,
      Problem: "Errors/discards increased",
      Detail:
        string(v: int(v: r._value)) +
        " event(s) / 5m"
    }))

union(
  tables: [
    stateProblems,
    counterProblems
  ]
)
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: [
    "Device",
    "Interface",
    "Problem"
  ])

panels.title: Selected Error / Discard Events

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ana-lab")
  |> range(
    start: v.timeRangeStart,
    stop: v.timeRangeStop
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._measurement == "net_ifcounters"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device != "R5"
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.device =~ /^${device:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r.interface =~ /^${interface:regex}$/
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._field == "in_errors" or
    r._field == "out_errors" or
    r._field == "in_discards" or
    r._field == "out_discards" or
    r._field == "in_fcs_errors"
  )
  |> group(columns: [
    "device",
    "interface",
    "_field"
  ])
  |> aggregateWindow(
    every: v.windowPeriod,
    fn: last,
    createEmpty: false
  )
  |> derivative(
    unit: 1s,
    nonNegative: true
  )
  |> filter(fn: (r) =>
    r._value > 0
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r._time,
    _value: float(v: r._value),
    _field:
      r.device + " " +
      r.interface + " " +
      (if r._field == "in_errors" then "RX errors"
       else if r._field == "out_errors" then "TX errors"
       else if r._field == "in_discards" then "RX discards"
       else if r._field == "out_discards" then "TX discards"
       else "FCS errors")
  }))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

panels.description: Shows only increases in error/discard counters. An empty panel means no new error/discard events occurred during the selected time range.
